result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with continuous sidewalks and rowhouses built to the property line. Pedestrian safety is limited by a lack of marked crossings and significant visual obstructions from parked vehicles on both sides of the roadway.

hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street creates a visual barrier between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the travel lanes.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly obstructed and hazardous, as the narrow paved walkway is completely blocked by parked vehicles and a large log. This lack of clear, protected space forces pedestrians to walk in the roadway, significantly increasing their exposure to traffic.

hazards.description: Parked vehicles and a large log completely block the narrow paved area adjacent to the building.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center, between the building and the roadway

hazards.description: No curb or physical barrier exists to prevent vehicles from parking on or encroaching upon the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire length of the building frontage

interventions.description: Construct a standard raised sidewalk with a vertical curb to physically separate pedestrians from vehicles and prevent parking on the walkway.

interventions.description: Clearly mark parking spaces and implement enforcement to ensure the pedestrian right-of-way remains unobstructed.

interventions.title: Debris Removal
